title: Hitler to Cookie Monster in five real photos
hook: How is Hitler connected to Cookie Monster?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Cookie Monster: Lord Halifax at the Berghof, Churchill, Queen Elizabeth II and Jill Biden.
fun_fact: When Lord Halifax arrived at the Berghof in 1937, he at first mistook Hitler for a footman. In 1940 Halifax could have become prime minister, but he stepped aside for Churchill.
research_note: No free photo of Halifax's 1937 Berghof visit exists, so that link uses Heinrich Hoffmann's press photo; every photo after it is public domain, ending at a 2011 USO show where Cookie Monster stood beside Jill Biden.

links.b: E. F. L. Wood, 1st Earl of Halifax

image.credit: Heinrich Hoffmann (ullstein bild), via Hitler Archive

links.line: In 1937, the British minister Lord Halifax visited Hitler at his Berghof mountain home.

links.a: E. F. L. Wood, 1st Earl of Halifax
links.line: In 1938, Halifax, now Britain's foreign secretary, walked through London with Winston Churchill.
In 1953, Churchill was back as prime minister, serving the young Queen Elizabeth the Second.

image.file: File:President Joe Biden and First Lady Jill Biden with Queen Elizabeth II (51269148664).jpg

links.line: In 2021, Queen Elizabeth welcomed First Lady Jill Biden and President Biden to Windsor Castle.

image.file: File:Jill Biden and Michelle Obama pose with some of the cast of Sesame Street, 2011.jpg

links.line: And in 2011, Jill Biden posed on stage in Ohio with Cookie Monster.
